content:
[Intro]
[Am]

[Verse 1]
[Am]I don't know just
[Am/G]how it happened,
[D9/F#]I let down my
[Fmaj7]guard
[Am]Swore I'd never
[Am/G]fall in love again
[D9/F#]but I fell hard
[Fmaj7]

[Verse 2]
[Am]Guess I should have
[Am/G]seen it coming;
[D9/F#]caught me by sur-
[Fmaj7]prise
[Am]I wasn't looking where I
[Am/G]was going; I
[D9/F#]fell into your eyes
[Fmaj7]
[E7]You came into my crazy
world

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am]Like a [Am/G]cool and clean-
[D9/F#]sing wave
[Fmaj7]Before I, I knew what
hit me, baby, you were
[E7]flowing though my
veins
I'm addicted to you,

[Chorus]
[Am]hooked on your love
[Am/G]Like a powerful drug
[D9/F#]I can't get enough of
[Fmaj7]
[Am]Lost in your eyes,
[Am/G]drowning in blue
[D9/F#]Out of control,
[Fmaj7]what can I do?
I'm addicted to you!

[Bridge]
[Am]

[Verse 3]
[Am]Midnight blows in
[Am/G]through the window;
[D9/F#]dances round the
[Fmaj7]room
[Am]Got me hypno-
[Am/G]tized; I'm getting
[D9/F#]high on the perfume
[Fmaj7]
[E7]I couldn't live
without you now, Oh,

[Pre-Chorus]
[Am]I know [Am/G]I'd go
[D9/F#]insane
[Fmaj7]I wouldn't last one night
alone, baby
[E7]I couldn't stand the
pain!
I'm addicted to you,

[Chorus]
[Am]hooked on your love
[Am/G]Like a powerful drug
[D9/F#]I can't get enough of
[Fmaj7]Lost in your eyes,
[Am]drowning in blue
[Am/G]Out of control,
[D9/F#]what can I
[Fmaj7]do?
I'm addicted to you!

[Outro]
[Am]
[Am/G]
[D9/F#]
[Fmaj7]
[Am]
[Am/G]
[D9/F#]
[Fmaj7]
[Am]
title: Addicted to You
tuning: E A D G B E
